entries.issuing_body: U.S. Department of the Treasury / Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC)
entries.title: OFAC suspends five Iran general licenses, including the personal-remittances authorization, with a September 8 wind-down
entries.facts: In a notice titled "Suspension of Certain Iranian Transactions and Sanctions Regulations General Licenses," OFAC states that on August 24, 2026 it announced it is issuing a rule "suspending indefinitely the effectiveness" of five general licenses issued under the Iranian Transactions and Sanctions Regulations, 31 CFR part 560: 31 CFR 560.544 (certain educational activities by U.S. persons in third countries), 31 CFR 560.550 ("Certain noncommercial, personal remittances to or from Iran authorized"), 31 CFR 560.554 (importation and exportation of services related to conferences), Iran General License F (certain services supporting professional and amateur sports activities and exchanges), and Iran General License G (certain academic exchanges and educational services). The notice states that OFAC is concurrently issuing General License BB, "authorizing all transactions prohibited by the ITSR that are ordinarily incident and necessary to the wind down of any transaction previously authorized by one or more of the above general licenses until September 8, 2026, subject to certain conditions," and that transactions previously authorized under the suspended licenses "are no longer authorized by OFAC, except to the extent authorized pursuant to General License BB until September 8, 2026." The notice directs parties seeking a specific license for covered activity occurring after the effective date of the suspension to OFAC's website.
